mapper.update: UPDATE competitor_products_clean c JOIN ( SELECT marketplace, COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_asin, ''), asin) AS dedup_key, MAX(m01_active) AS m01_active FROM competitor_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} GROUP BY marketplace, COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_asin, ''), asin) ) raw ON raw.marketplace = c.marketplace AND raw.dedup_key = c.dedup_key SET c.m01_active = raw.m01_active WHERE c.marketplace = #{marketplace}
